causal_conclusion: The existing final bridge is not a portable seed-independent capability package. Parent-bridge co-adaptation is larger than either measured main effect; exact routing and strong-parent identity exclude host and router failure.
architectural_requirement: The next ABI arm must keep one canonical LayerCake host immutable throughout acquisition and place all acquired corrective capability into a self-contained artifact trained against that exact host. It may not depend on a separately seed-trained parent state.
next_action: Design and seal one bounded immutable-canonical-host capability-artifact screen before training. Preserve the existing parameter, speed, information, and quality gates; use no final data and no matched baselines until a stable ABI candidate exists.
claim_boundary: Component attribution passes, but Phase 4 does not. There is no stable ABI frontier, minimum, runtime, matched-baseline, final-test, Phase 4 certificate, or superiority claim.
